html:
The Perth climate can have your home feeling super warm in the summer months and frosty during winter – but did you know that window tinting in Perth will help to keep your home at a more comfortable temperature all year round? Below, find out about our home window tinting Perth based services and the many benefits of home tinting in Perth.

Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted window tinting network. We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years and offer house tinting in Perth and many other cities throughout Australia. Here are the benefits of house window tinting in Perth and the types of films we offer.

House Window Tinting Perth

Because home tinting in Perth creates an insulating barrier to your windows this helps to keep heat out during the hotter months and the heat in during colder months. Home tinting Perth also reflects heat, which also helps to keep your home cooler during summer. Because it makes your air-con and heating more effective, it can have a positive impact on your power bills too! Other benefits of house window tinting Perth include:

  • Reduction in premature fading of furniture & flooring in your home
  • Increased security from break-ins
  • A safe home for you and your family if accidents or severe weather occurs and glass is broken
  • Protection from the damage caused by harmful UV rays
  • Privacy
  • A reduction in glare

Films We Use For Home Tinting Perth

We offer a range of films suitable for many different lifestyles. Our films come in lighter shades if you don’t want to alter the appearance of your home and privacy films obscure the view from the outside but still let natural light into your home during the day. Films in our home tinting Perth range include:

  • Solar window film
  • Security window film
  • Privacy window film
  • Safety window film
  • Frosted / decorative window film
  • Four seasons (environmentally friendly) window film
